klt sim monte_carlo keys the mismatch seed on the point's position, so the same sample_index is a different draw at each corner.
entries.note: Fix is OPT-IN; workaround kept. Re-checked 2026-11-20, uvx --from klayout-tools==0.9.2, `klt sim --dry-run --format json` on sim/oscillator-core/yield/request-nominal-mismatch.json (no simulation run): the request now declares `seed_scope: "shared" (as do all 25 committed campaign requests), and every sample_index resolves to one mismatch_seed across both endpoints (400/400 paired); the default (per_corner) still re-keys the draw per corner. The opt-in field, not the default, is what pairs the campaign, so the workaround (the yield plan's explicit seed contract) stays. Seed derivation only; no sample was simulated.

entries.gap: klt sim monte_carlo vary=process does not hold RNG-drawn mismatch fixed, so the documented sigma=0 negative control fails.
entries.note: Re-checked 2026-11-20, uvx --from klayout-tools==0.9.2, `klt sim --dry-run --format json` on sim/oscillator-core/yield/request-nominal-process.json (no simulation run): under vary=process the mismatch_seed is the same for all 400 samples of a corner (1 distinct value per corner, 2 over 2 corners) while process_seed differs per sample, so the seed-level control holds exactly as at 0.8.0. Upstream documents that a deck drawing from ngspice's own RNG (agauss/gauss) still changes per sample through rndseed; this deck's sigma=0 negative control was not simulated here. Workaround kept.

entries.gap: klt sim batch/remote has no runner-side simulator selection or version requirement; the request's engine_version pin (klayout-tools#3041) is checked only against the version the runner's report carried, after the run. A runner image that changes its simulator major re-runs previously validated routes on a different solver, and the first signal is per-unit aborts that look like design failures.
